request.style: English, female contralto solo with male choir, cello, harp, French horn, timpani, solemn and majestic, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Leah praised the Lord at last
She named the boy Judah
Fourth son of Jacob
Born in the house of Jacob

[Verse]
He spoke to his brothers
What do we gain by killing him
Come let us sell him
To the Ishmaelites

[Chorus]
The scepter shall not depart
From Judah nor his staff
The lion of the tribe
Shall rule in his strength

[Verse]
Tamar waited in grief
Her rights were denied
She sat on the road
Until she was denied

[Chorus]
The scepter shall not depart
From Judah nor his staff
The lion of the tribe
Shall rule in his strength

[Bridge]
Judah saw the pledge
Seal and cord and staff
She is more righteous than I
He did not sleep with her again

[Outro]
From Perez to the throne
The line of the lion
